contentBody.description: What type of information is the category team looking for in the customer assessment?

sections.content:
Below is a list of key considerations that the teams are reviewing. Underneath each is a qualifying answer for continuing on with Gaudi for the opportunity.

  • What is the main AI use cases that are being targeted?
    • Large language models, generative AI, computer vision

  • What kind of deployment is being considered?
    • On premises, hybrid, cloud

  • Which GenAI model providers is the customer working with/plans to work with?
    • This question is informational; there is no qualifying or disqualifying answer

  • What types of GenAI models are used / plan to use?
    • Test, image, audio, multimodal, video

  • Does the customer run HPC & AI workloads on the same hardware?
    • No, Gaudi is not designed to run traditional HPC workloads

  • What are the key relevant models including model sizes?
    • Hugging Face or Habana GitHub reference models; Open-sourced foundational models or their derivatives

  • For the specific model, does the customer use it for inference, fine-tuning, or training?
    • Training Models

  • If the customer's specific model is not publicly available, will they share it under CNDA? If no, is there a publicly available proxy we should refer to?
    • Yes, or provide pointer to proxy material

  • Does the model rely on dynamic shapes?
    • No, explore whether can be handled by standard "bucketing and padding"; can computation graph be broken into sections which are purely static & dynamic; can dynamic ops be rewritten into static form

  • Does the model use custom CUDA operators, and if so, what functions do they perform?
    • No custom operators or custom operators are already covered by SynapseAI kernels

  • Will the customer use Megatron DeepSpeed for training LLMs at scale?
    • Yes, not looking for customers using different scale-out libraries or unwilling to migrate

  • Does the customer use Hugging Face for access to models?
    • Yes, for scale customers

  • Do you require or use virtualization?
    • No, Gaudi does not support virtualization

  • Does the customer have an AI development team?
    • Yes, looking for highly technical customers who can participate in deep R&D engagements

  • What are the customer's biggest pain points in GenAI adoption?
    • This question is informational; there is no qualifying or disqualifying answer

  • What is the breakdown of training vs. fine-tuning vs inference by need & cycles?
    • This question is informational; there is no qualifying or disqualifying answer

  • What performance / cost benefits would justify changing their code?
    • This question is informational; there is no qualifying or disqualifying answer

  • Is the customer willing to be a public proof point for Intel?
    • This question is informational; there is no qualifying or disqualifying answer
